title: StandardMaterial doesn't work in webgl2 on Windows with DX12

labels.name: A-Rendering
labels.description: Drawing game state to the screen

labels.name: P-Regression
labels.description: Functionality that used to work but no longer does. Add a test for this!

labels.name: O-WebGL2
labels.description: Specific to the WebGL2 render API

body:
## Bevy version e67d63aa79bde2f9dcd72056657ce6f080fc2dda

The release number or commit hash of the version you're using.

The issue was introduced at 1f95a484ed111efa6ca2bf9c4d4f55719bc8200d with https://github.com/bevyengine/bevy/pull/8006.

## Relevant system information

- Windows 10, Nvidia RTX 3060

## What you did

Try to run the 3d_scene example in webgl2.

## What went wrong

### Update: I get this error with any scene that uses the `StandardMaterial`, not just ones with shadows
